title: Multisubject, multimodal face processing
description: A multimodal neuroimaging dataset comprising structural MRI, functional MRI, MEG, and EEG recordings from 16 subjects performing a face recognition task. The dataset includes anatomical and functional brain imaging alongside electrophysiological recordings during repeated presentations of famous, unfamiliar, and scrambled faces, designed to investigate multimodal integration of neuroimaging data in face processing.
methods_description: Data collection involved simultaneous or sequential acquisition of sMRI (MPRAGE T1 images), fMRI, MEG, and EEG during a face recognition task with three stimulus categories (famous, unfamiliar, scrambled faces) presented in initial and repeated conditions. MEG-MRI alignment was performed using three digitized anatomical fiducials (nasion and bilateral ears). fMRI preprocessing included removal of dummy volumes; MEG data included trigger codes for stimulus categorization.
